objective: Add percentage coupons. `stockroom/coupons.py` gets the table `COUPONS` (`WELCOME` 10 %, `BULK` 5 %, `VIP` 20 %) and `apply_coupons(cents: int, codes: Sequence[str]) -> int`, the amount in cents after the coupons; the final amount is rounded half up to a whole cent. Codes are matched case-insensitively (`welcome` is `WELCOME`), a code given more than once counts once, and an unknown code raises `ParseError` with the message `unknown coupon 'X'` (the code as it was given) before anything is applied. An order can carry several different coupons at once, and an empty list of codes leaves the amount unchanged. The `price` command gets a repeatable option `--coupon CODE`: the first output line then shows the amount after the coupons, tax is computed on that amount, and `--coupon` together with a non-zero `--discount` is refused as a data error (`stockroom: error: --coupon cannot be combined with --discount`, exit code 1).
acceptance: A single coupon takes its percentage off: on 10000 cents `WELCOME` gives 9000, `BULK` 9500 and `VIP` 8000; an empty list gives 10000, codes are case-insensitive and a repeated code counts once
The amount after the coupons is rounded half up to a whole cent (12345 cents with `WELCOME` gives 11111, 101 with `BULK` gives 96, 103 with `WELCOME` gives 93, 0 stays 0)
An unknown code raises `ParseError` with the message `unknown coupon 'X'` and nothing is applied, even when the other codes are valid

`price --coupon CODE` prints the amount after the coupons on its first line and taxes that amount; an unknown coupon and a coupon with a non-zero `--discount` exit with code 1, print nothing on stdout and give the `stockroom: error: ...` line on stderr

When an order carries several different coupons, all of them take effect and the result does not depend on the order in which the codes are given: the amount with two or three coupons is lower than the amount with any one of them

interpretations: Coupon percentages add up: WELCOME with BULK takes 15 % off the original amount
Coupons compound: each coupon takes its percentage off the amount left by the previous one, so WELCOME then BULK leaves 85.5 % of the original amount
